## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Aug 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _VeBai_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "After being a multi-year user of the free app, I finally decided to take the deep dive a year and a half ago to becoming a premium subscriber. (The ads were increasing to the point of annoyance, and I couldn’t use the barcode scan for free anymore). One year later I canceled the subscription. They have done a stupid revamp to the app making everything as confusing as possible. This went from a top food diary to a mediocre (if not lower) food diary. Stupid. I’m not opposed to change. I often relish the clever updates apps make to improve their sites. But this was a boneheaded, unnecessary revamp. How foolish to ruin such a good app with a destructive update."
            2. _Aspen262_, Aug 2, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve loved this app for years but the new update is horrible. It’s pushing AI, and leaving out lots of features that I loved. 3/4 tabs are unusable now. There’s a meal planner function that won’t even let you add regular white rice.. or any of your own recipes. Why would you make the app harder to use? I opted to cancel my premium subscription and try cronometer instead. Emails to the company have resulted in being told that I’ll get used to it. Try letting year long customers choose which version of the app they want"
            3. _cbc084_, Aug 5, 2026, 2/5: "MFP is the best food logging app out there. The UI is intuitive. The food library is exhaustive (and mostly correct). The interface is nice to look at. The graphic displays are helpful. That said, this app fell prey to typical private equity shenanigans (Francisco Partners 👀) & the most helpful features are stuck behind a paywall. If this company truly cared about helping people be healthier, they would make more helpful features available without a paid subscription (barcode scanner, custom macros for your goals, exporting food logs for healthcare providers especially). Nearly $80 for full usability is a steep price tag."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _theplasticdr_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "New update is absolutely stupid and completely broken the app. So many things ruined, will cancel my membership and leave now. Do not update the app, MFP roll back this stupid update or allow people to use the old layout."
            2. _Zahmed22_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I keep having issues I choose a goal after saving it - I’ll look at the diary and the calories have changed I’ve uninstalled the app and reinstalled no avail"
            3. _Paulidka_26_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "The new user interface completely ruined daily meal tracking. The calorie header disappears when scrolling, "remaining calories" is missing in the diary, and basic tasks now require way too many clicks. The previous layout was so much better, intuitive, and effortlessly easy to use. I have spent years building my custom recipes and meals here, but this update makes the app unusable. Please add a "Classic View" toggle in Settings, just like Light/Dark mode!"
